notes: Read the line-numbered source before editing; every one of the 136 source lines was considered. Imports L1-2: react useState/useMemo kept; react-i18next useTranslation (L2) replaced by a local native-safe useNativeTranslationFallback returning t(key, fallback?) = fallback ?? key (so the web's bare t('Vin Decoder') yields the human-readable key and t('devtools.utils.base64','Base64') yields the default — every key + i18n intent preserved). Lucide imports L3-6 (Car/Key/Clock/Braces/Link/Fingerprint/Hash/HardDrive/Palette/Timer/Network/BookOpen/Regex/Lock/ChevronDown) -> decorative AppText glyphs via the ICON_GLYPH map keyed by icon NAME (so base64+json keep the shared 'Braces' icon); exact glyph is a documented non-critical decorative stand-in.

L7 '@/components/ui' Button/Input/GlassPanel: GlassPanel maps to the native ../../../../../components/ui/GlassPanel; the ghost Button accordion header is reproduced as a native Pressable (accessibilityRole=button, accessibilityState={{expanded}}) and the Input is reproduced as a RN TextInput search field (autoCapitalize/autoCorrect off, placeholderTextColor token). L8 '@/lib/cn' dropped — native styling uses StyleSheet + tokens (colors/spacing/typography from ../../../../../theme/tokens). Import depth verified: file is 5 dirs under src (web-parity/features/admin/components/devtools) so ../../../../../ reaches src, matching the HelpSegment (4-deep) precedent.

L9 './constants' ICON_COLOR_MAP reproduced locally: the web value is a Tailwind class string (bg-neon-{c}/10 text-neon-{c} ring-1 ring-neon-{c}/20) which cannot apply on native, so the five colours (cyan/green/purple/amber/red) become native chip styles {backgroundColor,color,borderColor} mapped to the equivalent tokens (cyan→accent/accentSoft/borderAccent, green→success*, purple→violet*, amber→warning*, red→danger*), preserving the tinted-bg + tinted-text + ring intent. ICON_COLOR_MAP is re-exported to keep the constants' public shape. constants.ts is NOT in the parity manifest, so only the subset this file consumes is reproduced.

L11-25 the 15 tool imports + L33/L35 the ToolEntry icon (React.ElementType) and Component (React.ComponentType) fields: the tool bodies are separate web modules with their own conversion lifecycle (HttpStatusTool@428 + UuidGenerator@436 are later parity-manifest entries; the other 13 are out of native parity scope) and are NOT this section's responsibility. Mirroring the App.tsx parity precedent (unconverted page bodies represented as an explicit status panel, not imported), the ToolEntry.icon field becomes the lucide icon-NAME string and the Component field is replaced by a native-safe ToolUnavailableBody that names the tool and renders an explicit 'interactive UI provided by its own native module / not yet available' unavailable state (testID devtools-tool-body-<id>).

L29-36 ToolEntry interface ported (id/name/desc/color verbatim; icon -> icon-name string; Component dropped per above).
